title: Forward to the Past: Short-Term Effects of the Rent Freeze in Berlin
eligible_reason: Single policy (Berlin rent freeze) with one announcement date (June 2019) and one enactment date (Feb 2020) common to all treated listings; two-group, pre/post hedonic DiD estimated by penalized least squares (GAM) on repeated cross-sections of listings with no unit FE or calendar-time FE.
design_notes: Models (A), (B.1), (B.2): log(rent_it) on C_i (covered by freeze), Transition/Post-A/Post-E period dummies, C x period interactions, and time-invariant hedonic covariates including a smooth location spline. Table 6 main results: Treatment x Post-E = -0.113 (SE 0.019, N=26,842) in Strategy A; -0.075 (SE 0.022, N=3,314) in B.2. Table 5 reports monthly treatment effects (time dummies x treatment), Table 8 is a spatial difference-in-discontinuity at the Berlin-Brandenburg border, Table 9 is volume effects. Treated and control apartments are defined by building-year cutoff (new construction exempt). Not a staggered design.

ineligible_specs.reason: single adoption date; no unit FE; GAM with smooth location terms
monthly time dummies x treatment on repeated cross-section, single event date, no unit FE

screener_notes: Listing data from VALUE Marktdaten (commercial). Online tables referenced in the paper. Flag from 'difference-in-differences' wording.
